passage.text: Imagine working only four days a week and getting the same salary.
passage.reading: ɪˈmædʒɪn ˈwɜːrkɪŋ ˈoʊnli ˈfɔːr ˈdeɪz ə ˈwiːk ənd ˈɡɛtɪŋ ðə ˈseɪm ˈsæləri.

passage.text: It sounds too good to be true, but companies around the world are trying it.
passage.reading: ɪt ˈsaʊndz ˈtuː ˈɡʊd tə bi ˈtruː, bʌt ˈkʌmpəniz əˈraʊnd ðə ˈwɜːrld ər ˈtraɪɪŋ ɪt.

passage.text: In 2022, about sixty companies in the United Kingdom joined a six-month trial.
passage.reading: ɪn ˈtwɛnti ˈtwɛnti ˈtuː, əˈbaʊt ˈsɪksti ˈkʌmpəniz ɪn ðə juˈnaɪtɪd ˈkɪŋdəm ˈdʒɔɪnd ə ˈsɪks ˈmʌnθ ˈtraɪəl.

passage.text: Their employees worked four days a week, but they were paid the same.
passage.reading: ðɛr ɪmˈplɔɪiːz ˈwɜːrkt ˈfɔːr ˈdeɪz ə ˈwiːk, bʌt ðeɪ wɜːr ˈpeɪd ðə ˈseɪm.

passage.text: At the end of the trial, most of the companies decided to keep the four-day week.
passage.reading: ət ði ˈɛnd əv ðə ˈtraɪəl, ˈmoʊst əv ðə ˈkʌmpəniz dɪˈsaɪdɪd tə ˈkiːp ðə ˈfɔːr ˈdeɪ ˈwiːk.

passage.text: Employees said that they felt less stressed and slept better.
passage.reading: ɪmˈplɔɪiːz ˈsɛd ðæt ðeɪ ˈfɛlt ˈlɛs ˈstrɛst ənd ˈslɛpt ˈbɛtər.

passage.text: Their job satisfaction went up, and fewer people quit.
passage.reading: ðɛr ˈdʒɑːb ˌsætɪsˈfækʃən ˈwɛnt ˈʌp, ənd ˈfjuːər ˈpiːpəl ˈkwɪt.

passage.text: Productivity did not fall, and that surprised many people.
passage.reading: ˌproʊdʌkˈtɪvəti dɪd ˈnɑːt ˈfɔːl, ənd ðæt sərˈpraɪzd ˈmɛni ˈpiːpəl.

passage.text: When people have less time, they often become more efficient.
passage.reading: wɛn ˈpiːpəl ˈhæv ˈlɛs ˈtaɪm, ðeɪ ˈɔːfən bɪˈkʌm ˈmɔːr ɪˈfɪʃənt.

passage.text: They have shorter meetings, and they spend less time on social media at work.
passage.reading: ðeɪ ˈhæv ˈʃɔːrtər ˈmiːtɪŋz, ənd ðeɪ ˈspɛnd ˈlɛs ˈtaɪm ɑːn ˈsoʊʃəl ˈmiːdiə ət ˈwɜːrk.

passage.text: But could it work in Thailand?
passage.reading: bʌt kʊd ɪt ˈwɜːrk ɪn ˈtaɪlænd?

passage.text: Thai workers already work long hours, and many people believe that working hard means working long hours.
passage.reading: ˈtaɪ ˈwɜːrkərz ɔːlˈrɛdi ˈwɜːrk ˈlɔːŋ ˈaʊərz, ənd ˈmɛni ˈpiːpəl bɪˈliːv ðæt ˈwɜːrkɪŋ ˈhɑːrd ˈmiːnz ˈwɜːrkɪŋ ˈlɔːŋ ˈaʊərz.

passage.text: Some business owners worry that customers will not be happy if offices are closed on Fridays.
passage.reading: sʌm ˈbɪznəs ˈoʊnərz ˈwɜːri ðæt ˈkʌstəmərz wɪl ˈnɑːt bi ˈhæpi ɪf ˈɔːfɪsɪz ər ˈkloʊzd ɑːn ˈfraɪdeɪz.

passage.text: Also, a four-day week is easier for office workers than for doctors, teachers or factory workers.
passage.reading: ˈɔːlsoʊ, ə ˈfɔːr ˈdeɪ ˈwiːk ɪz ˈiːziər fər ˈɔːfɪs ˈwɜːrkərz ðən fər ˈdɑːktərz, ˈtiːtʃərz ɔːr ˈfæktəri ˈwɜːrkərz.

passage.text: Still, many young Thais say that they would love to try it.
passage.reading: ˈstɪl, ˈmɛni ˈjʌŋ ˈtaɪz ˈseɪ ðæt ðeɪ wʊd ˈlʌv tə ˈtraɪ ɪt.

passage.text: Maybe the real question is not "Can we work less?" but "Can we work better?"
passage.reading: ˈmeɪbi ðə ˈriːəl ˈkwɛstʃən ɪz ˈnɑːt kən wiː ˈwɜːrk ˈlɛs? bʌt kən wiː ˈwɜːrk ˈbɛtər?
